description: Shared cases for the length rule of both clients: a sanitised file name keeps at most 255 bytes of UTF-8 and keeps its extension only when the extension is at most 16 bytes. A name is its parts joined, each part a text repeated count times.

cases.name: an astral extension longer than 16 bytes is cut with the stem
an astral extension of 16 bytes is kept
an ASCII extension of 16 bytes is kept
an ASCII extension of 17 bytes is cut with the stem
a two-byte extension within 16 bytes is kept
a two-byte extension longer than 16 bytes is cut with the stem
the stem is cut at a whole character
only the last extension is kept
a three-byte stem is cut at a whole character
a name of 255 bytes stays whole
